WITH order_summary AS
  (SELECT oi.order_id,
          oi.user_id,
          u.traffic_source,
          SUM(oi.sale_price) AS order_total
   FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.thelook_ecommerce_agent.order_items` AS oi
   JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.thelook_ecommerce_agent.users` AS u ON oi.user_id = u.id
   WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled',
                           'Returned')
     AND oi.created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(TIMESTAMP '2026-11-25 02:09:08', INTERVAL 30 DAY)
   GROUP BY oi.order_id,
            oi.user_id,
            u.traffic_source),
     user_summary AS
  (SELECT user_id,
          traffic_source,
          COUNT(order_id) AS orders_count,
          SUM(order_total) AS user_total_spend
   FROM order_summary
   GROUP BY user_id,
            traffic_source)
SELECT traffic_source,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS total_customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN user_total_spend >= 100 THEN user_id
                      END) AS high_value_customers_spend_over_100,
       COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(order_total), 2) AS total_revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM order_summary
JOIN user_summary USING (user_id,
                         traffic_source)
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

WITH lead_time_metrics AS
  (SELECT p.distribution_center_id,
          AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.delivered_at, oi.shipped_at, DAY)) AS avg_delivery_lead_time_days
   FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.thelook_ecommerce_agent.order_items` AS oi
   JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.thelook_ecommerce_agent.products` AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id
   WHERE oi.order_id >= 9900000
     AND LOWER(p.department) = 'women'
     AND LOWER(p.category) = 'outerwear & coats'
     AND oi.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
     AND oi.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY p.distribution_center_id),
     inventory_metrics AS
  (SELECT ii.product_distribution_center_id AS distribution_center_id,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN ii.sold_at IS NULL THEN ii.cost
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS unsold_inventory_holding_cost
   FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.thelook_ecommerce_agent.inventory_items` AS ii
   WHERE LOWER(ii.product_department) = 'women'
     AND LOWER(ii.product_category) = 'outerwear & coats'
   GROUP BY ii.product_distribution_center_id)
SELECT dc.id AS distribution_center_id,
       dc.name AS distribution_center_name,
